A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LUMINA dataset, harmonization method and benchmark. All 12 pages of each version, including supplementary figures and tables, are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: V1 reports original classification experiments, backbone and harmonization comparisons, energy-specific results and Grad-CAM analyses in Section 6, with additional fold-level ROC results in the supplement.

after.justification: V3 retains the original experimental results in Section 6 and the supplementary ROC analyses. These remain original empirical results despite being unchanged from v1.

M1.justification: Foreground-only CDF matching, background preservation, preprocessing and shared-backbone CC/MLO feature fusion remain unchanged in Sections 4–5 and Algorithm 1. Shorter descriptions do not alter the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 1,824 images from 468 patients across six acquisition systems, with diagnosis, binary/three-class BI-RADS and four-class density tasks. Energy-specific evaluation coverage is also unchanged; the added dataset link introduces no new evaluated data.

E2.justification: Tables 4–6 retain ResNet-50, DenseNet-121, EfficientNet-B0 and Swin-T in the same comparisons. Shared versus independent backbones and raw versus harmonized inputs retain their original comparator membership.

E3.justification: Task inclusion rules, sample counts, five-fold evaluation, input resolutions, metrics and training settings are unchanged. Sections 3.1 and 6.1 and supplementary Tables 9–10 retain the same preprocessing, optimization and 100-epoch schedule.

E4.justification: The backbone-sharing ablation, resolution/view comparisons, harmonization analysis, energy-stratified evaluation, t-SNE plots and Grad-CAM cases are retained. Supplementary ROC analyses are unchanged, and Figure 7's caption corrections introduce no new case study.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard deviations over five folds, retain the same determinism statement, and show fold-level ROC curves with standard-deviation bands in supplementary Figures 9–10. No statistical reporting procedure or run-count information is added.

E6.justification: Numerical results and plotted findings remain unchanged in Tables 4–7 and Figures 5–10, including diagnosis AUC 93.54% and density macro-AUC 89.43%. Figure 7 changes laterality labels while retaining the same images and qualitative comparison.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8 retain the same foreground masks, histogram counts, normalized CDFs, intensity mapping and output definition. Neither version adds or changes formal assumptions, proofs or mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The rewritten abstract and conclusion retain the same contributions: a multi-vendor, energy-annotated dataset, foreground harmonization and a three-task benchmark. Claims about two-view modeling, harmonization benefits and attention localization retain their scientific scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning image resolution, shared-backbone efficiency, focal attention and larger harmonization benefits for low-energy images remain unchanged. No substantive applicability boundary, failure condition or limitation is added or removed.

D1.justification: Section 8 adds a Kaggle dataset access link alongside the existing OSF dataset and GitHub code links. This expands documented access options; implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware and supplementary preprocessing instructions remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Both versions retain the same 34 references and the same research positioning in Section 2 and supplementary Table 8, including comparisons with existing mammography datasets, ComBat and HarmoFL.

P1.justification: V3 rewrites and condenses the abstract and conclusion, shortens the harmonization contribution bullet, and makes local wording and grammar corrections, including the acknowledgment and supplementary prose. Section order and the overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves from page 1 to page 2. Figure 7(b–c) captions change from 83L/105L to 83R/105R while retaining the images. Access links become a list, text reflows and page-number footers disappear; other figure and table displays are preserved.

improvement.justification: V3 modestly improves reporting through corrected Figure 7 laterality captions, streamlined prose and an additional documented dataset access route. These provide limited clarity and usability gains. The methods, experimental evidence and technical reproducibility details remain unchanged.
